summary: Italy (IT) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Italian VAT (non-deductible VAT, settlement, VAT transaction reports, Datifattura), withholding tax and INPS contributions, customer and vendor bills with SEPA payments, FatturaPA e-invoicing, Intrastat, fiscal inventory valuation, Italian depreciation methods, and legacy subcontracting.
overview:
The Italian layer is large: 552 objects, 829 fields added to W1 tables, 92 events and 337 procedures. Most W1 documents, ledger entries and setup tables get Italian fields such as Fiscal Code, Operation Type, Operation Occurred Date, Activity Code, Deductible %, Service Tariff No., Individual Person and Resident. These feed VAT posting, VAT settlement and the VAT transaction reports. Codeunits 12, 80, 90, 442 and 444 carry the posting logic and many of the new events.

Own objects add withholding tax and contribution handling, customer and vendor bill processing with SEPA credit transfer and direct debit, FatturaPA and Datifattura export, and Spesometro, annual VAT communication and VAT payment communication. They also add fiscal inventory valuation (LIFO, year-end costs), transport documents (transport reason codes, goods appearance, third-party loaders), Intrastat report extensions and service declarations. Payment terms get installment lines (table 12170 "Payment Lines").

Learn documents most of this under Italy local functionality, Italian VAT, VAT transactions reports, Fattura electronic invoicing, automatic payments and bills, withholding tax, fiscal inventory valuation and Italian fixed assets. Italian subcontracting is deprecated in favor of the Subcontracting app. Several legacy subcontracting codeunits and a migration app support the move.
key_points: VAT: Deductible %, non-deductible VAT amounts, reverse charge, Operation Occurred Date and Include in VAT Transac. Rep. on VAT Entry, journal and document lines.
Periodic VAT settlement (report 20 "Calc. and Post VAT Settlement") with settlement period, round factor and minimum payable set in General Ledger Setup.
VAT transaction reports: suggest lines by threshold, validate, release, export as .ccf, correct or cancel, record tax authority receipt numbers.
Bills and payments: customer and vendor bills, bill posting groups, ABI/CAB on bank accounts, SEPA credit transfer and direct debit exports.
FatturaPA e-invoicing for sales and service documents, self-billing, Fattura Setup with codes and document types, and Datifattura export.
Withholding tax and INPS contributions are set up on the vendor and calculated at payment, with an export and printed reports.
Fiscal inventory valuation (average, FIFO, LIFO, discrete LIFO), initial item costs, and Italian anticipated, accelerated and reduced depreciation with compression.
Intrastat journal and report changes, a fiscal deny list on countries and vendors, and deprecated legacy subcontracting with a migration app.

areas.what: Adds Italian VAT fields to general journal, VAT entry, VAT posting setup and invoice buffers. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gets events and procedures for bills, unrealized VAT and non-deductible VAT. VAT statement, VAT settlement and VAT transaction report objects are extended, and Spesometro, withholding and intent declaration exports are added.
areas.why: Learn describes Italian VAT with non-deductible VAT, service tariffs and reverse charges. It also describes VAT transaction reports sent to the tax authorities.

areas.what: Adds customer and vendor bill handling: bill cards, issued and posted bill lists, recall and posting codeunits, and ABI/CAB codes. Bank Account and Payment Method gain Italian fields, and SEPA credit transfer and direct debit codeunits are adapted for bills. Withholding and contribution pages are also listed here.
areas.why: Learn documents automatic payments and bills with SEPA formats and bill codes on payment methods.

areas.what: Adds Italian objects for service documents: page extensions on service orders, invoices and credit memos, edit codeunits for posted documents, and service declarations (Intrastat for services) with periodicity and report type enums. Serv-Documents Mgt. gets a payment term lines procedure.

Extends transfer orders with transport document data (weights, loader, reason code, goods appearance) and Intrastat journal tables with Italian fields. Adds fiscal inventory valuation objects (LIFO, item cost history, customs offices) and an Intrastat report extension. Transfer lines and item journal lines carry subcontracting WIP fields.
areas.why: Learn documents fiscal inventory valuation methods, initial item costs and Intrastat reporting with corrective entries.

areas.what: Sales documents, archives and posted documents get Italian fields (operation type, activity code, fiscal code, tax representative, Fattura project code). Customer gets fiscal code, PA code and bill fields. Sales-Post gets events for payment lines and VAT report validation, and split VAT lines are supported.

Purchase documents get Italian fields (operation type, check total, reverse sales VAT numbering, activity code). Vendor gains fiscal code, withholding tax, social security and birth data. Purch.-Post adds events for withholding tax, payment lines and fixed asset card splitting, and customs authority vendors are added.
areas.why: Learn documents withholding tax set up on the vendor and calculated at payment, and the fiscal deny list for vendors.

areas.what: Implements Italian subcontracting with subcontracting orders, transfer orders, prices and dispatch reports, plus WIP item fields on routing and capacity entries. Legacy subcontracting codeunits and a migration codeunit support the move to the Subcontracting app.
areas.why: Learn states the Italian subcontracting is deprecated and replaced by the Subcontracting app, with migration for sandbox environments.

areas.what: Extends Company Information, Payment Terms, Country/Region, Shipment Method, Shipping Agent and No. Series with Italian fields. Adds payment lines for installment terms, company officials and types, and operation types. Country/Region gets deny list fields.
areas.why: Learn describes payment terms with installments and the fiscal denial list for countries.

areas.what: Adds FatturaPA electronic invoicing: export and validation codeunits for sales and service documents, self-billing export, Fattura setup, codes, project info, header and line tables.
areas.why: Learn explains FatturaPA invoicing to public administration through the SDI platform, with setup of VAT groups and document types.

areas.what: Adds anticipated, accelerated and reduced depreciation through depreciation table percentages and depreciation book settings. Adds depreciation compression in FA Jnl.-Post Batch and an Italian Depreciation Book report.
areas.why: Learn documents alternate depreciation methods, compressed depreciation and the Depreciation Book report.

areas.what: Holds Italian No. Series extensions, upgrade codeunits for detailed ledger and VAT settlement entries, the Intra-form buffer and a CBI payment request XMLport.
Adds activity codes, appointment codes, Spesometro appointments and check fiscal code setup, plus Italian application management and report management codeunits.
Adds a flat file management codeunit, a blacklist communication amount table and a document relation table.
Changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets and the VAT Report - Edit permission set for Italian objects.
Adds a feature management codeunit and extends application area setup with a premium experience area and a legacy subcontracting area.
Employee gets birth place fields. The employee application codeunit adds checks for VAT settlement and unrealized VAT.
Cash Flow Worksheet Line gains events and procedures for posted and unposted documents, credit memo handling and payment tolerance.
Contact gets a Fiscal Code field and a procedure for transport document address data.
Job Transfer Line adds a reverse charge VAT amount calculation and an event on purchase line transfer.

issues: Overview says codeunits 12, 80, 90, 442 and 444 carry 'many of the new events'. Together they add 25 of the 92 events (10, 6, 7, 1 and 1). That is a fair share, not most.
Key point 1 puts Operation Occurred Date on document lines. In the input it is on journal lines, VAT entries and document headers, not document lines.

Key point 6 says INPS contributions are calculated at payment. Learn only says this for withholding tax. The vendor setup and payment posting are shared, so this is a reasonable inference, but no source states it.
Key point 5 says Fattura Setup has codes. Learn describes Fattura Setup with VAT business groups and document types. Fattura Codes is a separate page.
